title: Evaluation of a three-line program
statement: Let $p$ specify three straight-line Boolean operations, with operations $o_1,o_2,o_3$ and literals $l_1,l_2,l_3,l_4$, and let $x$ be a Boolean assignment to its inputs. The program evaluates to $o_3\bigl(o_1(x_{l_1}=b_1,x_{l_2}=b_2),o_2(x_{l_3}=b_3,x_{l_4}=b_4)\bigr)$, where each literal $l_i$ consists of an input coordinate and a Boolean sign $b_i$, and $x_{l_i}=b_i$ denotes equality of that input value with the sign.
hypotheses_covered: A three-line shape $p$ specifying its three operations and four signed input literals
A Boolean assignment $x$ to the inputs
